strongest_objection: The triple target may be unable to separate mechanism from cheap control in principle, because every honest fair online cheap control (online count/statistic, FSM, graph/cache, kNN) is itself a process with real intervention-sensitive internal updates: intervene on its inputs and its response changes; its table delta is a real emittable internal update trace; delete or freeze its table and its later behavior really changes. The conjunction is therefore satisfied existence-wise by construction, and the only possible separator is a quantitative or structural signature of update dynamics — which the card does not freeze (no state-delta metric definitions, no match criterion, no thresholds, no separation statistic). The future executable task thus either fails immediately as a foregone negative or passes only via a post-hoc metric choice, i.e., trace theater relocated from the trace to the metric. Because no trace-commitment protocol exists, post-hoc trace generation cannot be distinguished from online emission, making the anti-theater gates unenforceable as specified; and because no real-implementation rule exists, the controls meant to force failure may never actually run — the exact false-pass mechanism of REPRESENTATIONAL-GAP-PREFLIGHT-001A. Unless A1–A5 are incorporated before authorization, the new proxy remains trace theater risk wrapped in stronger language.
